scope: Isolated flat fixtures, five attackers from three explicit mixes; identical initial positions, units, seed and income/replacement settings for each controller within a case/mix/seed/mirror. Opponents always independent. Most cases fixed force/no recruitment; supplied-fob enables normal paid HQ replacements for both, platoon leader loss cancels its orders. Initial four attack followers and defenders are explicit scenario grants; all controllers pay25 for equivalent fifth rifle, leaving95 of120 Supply. Initial full force replacement value reported separately; do not double count that25 in total resource value. No helicopter, normal commander or natural campaign victory claim. Mirrored colors are paired robustness checks, not independent seeds. Unfinished is not a draw. No injected damage or forced wins after fixture initialization.
